objective: Converge a third member of the family-N a10 model-form band: Spalart-Allmaras under an adjusted-but-preregistered settle criterion, then re-state containment of the CFL3D references at n=3
rationale: The first family-N band, produced after the R12 regrade, contains the reference Cd but misses the reference Cl by 0.22 percent on a two-member band, and the negative-verdict review's entry 11 rules that a miss this small at n=2 indicts the membership before the models: an n=2 min-max band is a lower bound on the true spread. SA's exclusion was residualControl non-attainment, not divergence: the archived 12000-iteration run shows the pressure residual on a flat plateau near 2.5e-6 against its 1e-6 target from iteration 2000 to 12000 and nuTilda floored at 1.6e-8 against 1e-8, while the lift coefficient holds an 8.6e-6 peak-to-peak over the final 2000 iterations, 278 times below the 2.4e-3 containment gap the band decision turns on. That is an unreachable-tolerance stop of the same class the periodic-hill record already closed by setting reachable criteria, not an unconverged flow. The arm re-runs the SA cell with numerics, schemes and residual targets untouched, and replaces only the declaration of done: a pre-registered plateau-plus-decision-scale criterion committed before the solve, chosen from the archived run's measured floors and from the containment gap rather than from anything the new run does. Either n=3 outcome writes a rule: if the reference Cl enters, the standing rule proposal is that no containment verdict is stated below three members; if it stays outside on a three-member band, the miss is real and aero-family bands need a membership-minimum rule.
gate: The run is admitted as a band member only if every clause of the pre-registered adjusted criterion holds, evaluated mechanically by the runner and stamped into the cell record: solver exit zero with no S1 or S2 fatal, every residual floored within one decade of its standard target with less than a factor-two fall across the final quarter of the history, the S12 settle test on the quantity histories, and trailing-2000-iteration peak-to-peak of Cl and Cd each at or below ten percent of the decision distance the containment question turns on. Any clause failing leaves SA excluded, the n=2 miss standing, and the membership-minimum branch fires. Containment at n=3 is then re-stated from the runner's own band regeneration, R12 statement carried
cost_basis: measured: the identical SA cell ran twice at 1.08 and 1.12 core-min for 12000 iterations on one core; ten covers the re-run with an eightfold margin for a longer tail
expected_knowledge_gain: Either the family's first aero band gains a third member and the lab gains the rule that containment verdicts need at least three members, or the miss survives a three-member band and the lab gains a measured case for a membership-minimum rule on aero bands. Both outcomes convert a 0.22 percent anomaly into an operating rule; the arm also measures SA's solve-to-solve reproducibility on the canonical C-grid at one core-minute
citations: The supervisor negative-verdict review of 2026-08-07, entry 11, wording binding
The model-form band artifact, group N a10, generated after the R12 regrade

decision_note: Approved under the chief's standing green light relayed 2026-08-08 with the review's wording binding; pre-registration committed before the solve per the fleet's standing rule.
outcome: Executed 2026-08-08 at 1.07 of 10 core-min, pre-registration committed ten seconds before launch (9374f807). SA reproduced the archived run to every printed digit (Cl 1.0290489902, Cd 0.016192147753) and met every clause of the adjusted criterion with 28x and 54x margins on the decision-scaled caps; all three predictions HELD. At n=3 the Cl band [1.0290490, 1.1164337] CONTAINS CFL3D's 1.0778081 -- the 0.22 percent n=2 miss was under-membership exactly as entry 11 read it, the third member entering 0.051 below the old floor. Declared branch fired: rule proposal no-containment-verdict-below-n3 filed. One wrapper defect found and fixed in the act: the runner's workflow-error conservatism briefly outranked the registered criterion; the record was corrected to the pre-registered wording with the superseded record retained, all documented in the pre-registration's outcome section.
